mapper.insert: insert into fitian.Box (boxName, boxCode, boxContact, boxAddress, boxScript, boxInsta, placeId) value (#{boxName},#{boxCode},#{boxContact},#{boxAddress},#{boxScript},#{boxInsta},#{placeId})
mapper.update:
update fitian.Box SET
boxContact=#{boxContact},
boxAddress=#{boxAddress},
boxScript=#{boxScript},
boxInsta=#{boxInsta},
boxFeeUrl=#{boxFeeUrl},
boxTimeTableUrl=#{boxTimeTableUrl},
boxCode=#{boxCode} where boxCode = #{boxCode}
